This section is commented out in `stylized-facts.qmd`; it is carried here so the claim is not lost. Treat as a draft.
:::

**The ease of verifying the outputs of a task is the most important attribute in leading LLMs to be successful at a task.**

If a task’s outputs are easily verifiable by both expert humans and a computer this is associated with a 1.4 unit (on a five-point scale) increase in frontier LLM performance on average.

![](images/image14.png){.column-margin}

The degree to which the verification can occur autonomously (by computers not expert humans) has gotten more important with reasoning models.
